newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.50 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.50 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Thursday conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money market at 3.50 percent, traders said.
They said the central bank intervened after the call loan or overnight lending rate traded at the top of the bank's 3.0-3.50 percent target range.
The call loan rate was bid at 3.50 percent and offered at 3-5/8 percent after the central bank intervened on the money market a second time, said one dealer.
"It should have a little bit of a moderating effect, but call loan is trading at a half on the bid side," the dealer said.
Dealers said the demand for overnight money was being prompted by month-end pressures and the fact it is year end for many banks. Those pressures could prompt a third round of specials.
"He (the bank) will do them if it still maintains a profile above a half I'm sure," the dealer said.
